features.title: Application fields that stay clear
features.before: The fields currently use a thin underline and floating labels.
features.after: Permanent labels above outlined inputs make the form easier to scan and revisit.

features.title: Mobile hero facts with room to breathe
features.before: Long values wrap into a narrow space beside the icons.
features.after: Keep the icons; give each value the full width of its column. Applies to BCA, MCA, SIF and homepage facts.

features.title: Remove the empty Cookie Policy sidebar
features.before: The contents sidebar has no links, but still takes up a full column.
features.after: A centred reading column, with no empty navigation.

features.title: Easier policy-page reading
features.before: Long lines and heavy heading weights make dense policy text harder to scan.
features.after: A narrower measure, calmer headings and more consistent paragraph spacing. Original policy words retained.

features.title: A footer with clear groups
features.before: Navigation, policies, social links and copyright share one busy row.
features.after: Separate Explore, Policies and Services groups, plus a more readable disclosure. All existing links and disclosure words retained.

features.title: Clearer calculator result hierarchy
features.before: Controls, result and small print are compressed into one beige panel.
features.after: A white calculator surface, a distinct estimate area and larger tab targets. Calculations remain unchanged.

features.title: Contact fields with visible labels
features.before: The contact form relies on placeholder text to identify its fields.
features.after: Labels remain above each field after someone starts typing. Softer white inputs replace the grey blocks.

features.title: A shorter mobile blog filter area
features.before: Eight wrapped topic buttons delay the first article on a small screen.
features.after: A compact, labelled topic selector on mobile. Desktop filters and article content stay the same.

features.title: A more comfortable article reading column
features.before: Long article titles and body lines compete with the contents column.
features.after: A more balanced title size, a 68-character reading measure and clearer subheading rhythm.

features.title: Mobile FAQ topics as a clear list
features.before: Two columns of topic links have uneven line wraps and can be harder to tap.
features.after: One clean list with generous tap areas and consistent separators.

features.title: Introducer FAQs you can scan first
features.before: The imported FAQ answers start expanded, creating a very long page.
features.after: Start with the questions, add a question count and offer Expand all / Collapse all. All 14 answers stay available.

features.title: A bank directory that scans faster
features.before: Large centred logo cards use a lot of vertical space.
features.after: Compact logo-and-name rows, a clearer search area and a quieter availability notice. Live connections remain unavailable.

features.title: A cleaner bank connection form
features.before: The availability notice and bordered form create several nested boxes on mobile.
features.after: A compact notice and a single aligned form column. The real connection button remains disabled.

features.title: Thank-you pages with a clear next action
features.before: A large empty area and adjacent text links make the page feel unfinished.
features.after: A compact confirmation layout with clearly separated next actions. These pages remain static templates.

features.title: Correct wayfinding on resource pages
features.before: Policy and Open Banking pages currently highlight Blog as the active page.
features.after: Remove the misleading Blog highlight and add a simple Home / current page breadcrumb.

features.title: Make the full partner FAQ easier to find
features.before: The separate introducer FAQ link sits away from the main partner questions.
features.after: Put a clear link beside the partner FAQ section, where people are already looking for answers.

audit: 76 page-size checks; no document overflow, broken image references or page-script errors observed. Visual recommendations only; this is not a legal or compliance certification.
